content: Dynamic QR encodes a short URL so destination can change after print. PNG is for screens; SVG is expected for print. WhatsApp FAQ: https://wa.me/{digits}?text=urlencoded. Pix: BCB BR Code EMV MPM; camera URL redirects do not pay—landing must show merchant-presented BR Code. vCard dynamic codes use a landing with downloadable vCard 3.0, not a static payload in the printed QR. Status virgin/active/paused is expected for physical plates.
